Mark it down, Pasco — The Brick Who Stole Christmas is coming for Whoville and it's getting a full Latinx glow-up 🟢🎄 Tahboo's leading the charge with the Who Queens right behind, and they're about to turn every classic carol inside out with drag, comedy, and chaos nobody saw coming. This is the one holiday show you tell your group chat about before it sells out. Doors open at 8, show starts at 9 — grab your spot before the Grinch grabs it first 💚✨
